description: End-to-end order-to-cash workflow for SASE connectivity services, from design and quoting through provisioning, activation, monitoring, and billing.

customer_id.description: Unique identifier of the enterprise customer

site_id.description: Unique identifier of a customer site/location

design_id.description: Identifier for a SASE design or solution blueprint

quote_id.description: Identifier of a commercial quote for SASE connectivity services

order_id.description: Identifier of a SASE service order

line_item_id.description: Identifier of an individual order line item (e.g., per site/access type)

service_request_id.description: Identifier of a provisioning or change request ticket

subscription_id.description: Identifier of an active SASE subscription

policy_profile_id.description: Identifier of a security or routing policy profile

functions.name: design_sase_solution
functions.description: Create a high-level SASE connectivity design for a customer across multiple sites.

customer_id.description: Customer for whom the design is being created

design_name.description: Human-readable name of the SASE design

sites.description: List of sites to be included in the design

internet_breakout.description: Whether site requires direct internet breakout

tags.description: Arbitrary key-value pairs for tagging the design

functions.returns: Design ID, summary of recommended topology and feature set per site

functions.name: check_connectivity_feasibility
functions.description: Check technical and commercial feasibility of the designed SASE connectivity for all sites.

sites_override.description: Optional subset of sites to re-evaluate; if omitted, evaluates all sites in the design

site_id.description: Existing site identifier within the design

feasibility_depth.description: Level of detail for feasibility check

include_alternatives.description: Whether to include alternative access technologies if primary is not feasible

functions.returns: Per-site feasibility status, recommended access types, and any constraints or required design changes

functions.name: create_sase_quote
functions.description: Create a commercial quote based on a feasible SASE design.

special_approval_code.description: Identifier of any approved special discount

functions.returns: Quote ID, summarized recurring and one-time charges, and validity period

functions.name: convert_quote_to_order
functions.description: Convert an accepted quote into a SASE service order with line items per site.

quote_id.description: Previously generated quote to convert from

customer_id.description: Customer placing the order (may differ in multi-entity scenarios)

site_specific_overrides.description: Optional overrides per site compared to the quoted configuration

accept_terms.description: Indicates that the customer has accepted the terms and conditions

functions.returns: Order ID, list of line_item_ids per site, and initial order status

functions.name: validate_sase_order
functions.description: Perform technical and commercial validation of a newly created SASE order.

line_items.description: Optional subset of line items to validate; if omitted, validates all

functions.returns: Validation status per line item, list of blocking issues, and recommended remediation actions

functions.name: update_sase_order
functions.description: Modify an existing SASE order before or during provisioning (e.g., change bandwidth or access type).

changes.description: List of granular changes to apply to the order

effective_date.description: Date when the change should become effective

parameters.description: Polymorphic object with fields depending on change_type

service_features.description: Features to add or remove when change_type is add_service_feature or remove_service_feature

reason.description: Free-form description of reason for order change

functions.returns: Updated order snapshot, new or updated line_item_ids if applicable, and any required re-validation flags

functions.name: cancel_or_rollback_sase_order
functions.description: Cancel an order or rollback changes depending on the current delivery stage.

apply_cancellation_charges.description: Indicates if any applicable cancellation charges should be applied

functions.returns: Cancellation or rollback result, including impacted line items and any financial impact

functions.name: initiate_provisioning_request
functions.description: Create provisioning or change service requests for one or more order line items.

line_items.description: Line items to provision or change

initial_policy_profile_id.description: Optional policy profile to attach at provisioning

functions.returns: List of service_request_ids created per line item and their initial states

functions.name: get_provisioning_status
functions.description: Retrieve current status, milestones, and any blocking issues for provisioning requests.

service_request_ids.description: Identifiers of provisioning or change requests to check

include.description: Additional details to include in the response

functions.returns: Per-service_request_id status, key timestamps, blocking issues, and next actions

functions.name: retry_or_escalate_provisioning
functions.description: Retry failed provisioning steps or escalate stalled requests.

context.description: Additional context required for specific actions

failure_reference.description: Identifier of the failure event to retry

preferred_time_window.description: Customer-preferred time window for field or activation

vendor_ticket_reference.description: Existing vendor ticket to associate with the escalation

notes.description: Reason and context for the retry or escalation

functions.returns: Updated provisioning workflow status, any new sub-tickets created, and expected next update time

functions.name: activate_and_bind_policies
functions.description: Activate provisioned SASE services, bind policy profiles, and create subscriptions for billing.

activation_batch.description: List of line items to activate in this batch

functions.returns: Per line item activation result, created subscription_ids, and bound policy_profile_ids

functions.name: get_sase_subscription
functions.description: Retrieve details and operational status of SASE subscriptions and associated sites.

subscription_id.description: Primary subscription to fetch; if omitted, must filter by customer_id

customer_id.description: Customer used for listing subscriptions when subscription_id is not provided

functions.returns: Subscription profile, associated sites and policies, operational and SLA status, and recent usage metrics

functions.name: generate_and_get_invoice
functions.description: Generate or fetch invoices related to SASE subscriptions for the order-to-cash cycle.
functions.returns: Invoice ID, financial breakdown per subscription/site, taxes, and payment status metadata

functions.name: bulk_import_sase_orders
functions.description: Bulk-import multiple sase_orders from an upstream source with validation and idempotency keys.

mapping.description: Field mapping from source to canonical schema

functions.returns: A bulk-import job descriptor with counts of accepted, rejected, and quarantined sase_orders, plus a job_id for follow-up.

functions.name: bulk_update_sase_orders
functions.description: Apply a partial update to a batch of sase_orders matched by filter or id list.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

patch.description: Fields to patch on each matched item

functions.returns: Summary of matched, updated, and skipped sase_orders with per-item error details.

functions.name: bulk_archive_sase_orders
functions.description: Archive (soft-delete) a batch of sase_orders with retention metadata and audit reasons.
functions.returns: Per-id archive results with new lifecycle state.

functions.name: bulk_export_sase_orders
functions.description: Export a filtered set of sase_orders to a downstream destination (S3, GCS, blob, SFTP).

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Export job handle including job_id, expected object URIs, row count, and signed download URLs when applicable.

functions.name: search_sase_orders_advanced
functions.description: Advanced faceted search across sase_orders with full-text, structured filters, aggregations, and sort.

query.description: Full-text query string with Lucene-like syntax

functions.returns: Search response with sase_orders hits, total count, aggregation buckets, and a next-cursor.

functions.name: create_sase_order_subscription
functions.description: Create a subscription that fires webhooks or notifications on sase_order lifecycle events.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: The created subscription including subscription_id, active state, and last_delivery info (initially null).

functions.name: list_sase_order_subscriptions
functions.description: List existing sase_order subscriptions with optional filters and pagination.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated list of subscription objects including delivery health stats.

functions.name: deactivate_sase_order_subscription
functions.description: Deactivate or delete a sase_order subscription and optionally flush pending deliveries.
functions.returns: Updated subscription state and the number of pending deliveries flushed or kept.

functions.name: get_sase_order_audit_log
functions.description: Return the audit/change log for a single sase_order with field-level diffs and actor info.

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Chronological list of audit events with before/after diffs, actor, and source IP/system.

functions.name: search_audit_events
functions.description: Search audit events across sase_orders for compliance and forensic review.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated audit-event hits with cross-entity references.

functions.name: schedule_sase_order_job
functions.description: Create a recurring schedule that triggers a named operation on a target set of sase_orders.

operation.description: Named operation to invoke (e.g., refresh, recompute, export, reconcile)

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: The created scheduled-job descriptor with job_id, next_run_at, and current status.

functions.name: list_sase_order_jobs
functions.description: List scheduled or in-flight jobs related to sase_orders with status filtering and pagination.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated list of sase_order jobs and their last run summaries.

functions.name: cancel_sase_order_job
functions.description: Cancel a scheduled or in-flight sase_order job, optionally interrupting running steps.
functions.returns: Updated job status with cancellation timestamp and any side effects.

functions.name: simulate_sase_order_change
functions.description: Simulate a proposed change against a sase_order (or batch) without committing; returns expected diffs and warnings.
functions.returns: Simulation result with predicted diffs, rule violations, cost/SLA impact, and a confidence score.

functions.name: request_sase_order_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a sensitive sase_order change requiring reviewer sign-off.
functions.returns: Created approval request with approval_request_id, current state, and notification targets.

functions.name: submit_sase_order_approval_decision
functions.description: Submit an approve, reject, or request-changes decision against a sase_order approval request.
functions.returns: Updated approval request state including quorum progress and final decision (if reached).

functions.name: add_sase_order_comment
functions.description: Append a comment or annotation to a sase_order, optionally attaching files or mentioning users.
functions.returns: The created comment object with comment_id, timestamps, and visibility-resolved permissions.

functions.name: list_sase_order_comments
functions.description: List comments and annotations attached to a sase_order, with optional thread expansion.
functions.returns: Paginated comment list with thread tree and attachment metadata.

functions.name: snapshot_sase_order
functions.description: Create a point-in-time immutable snapshot of a sase_order for forensic, rollback, or compliance use.
functions.returns: Snapshot descriptor with snapshot_id, checksum, byte size, and retention expiry.

functions.name: restore_sase_order_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a sase_order from a previously created snapshot, optionally as a new copy.
functions.returns: Restore job descriptor including resulting id and any per-field conflicts that were resolved.

functions.name: get_sase_order_metrics
functions.description: Compute KPI metrics over sase_orders (counts, MTTR, SLA compliance, error rates) for a time window.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Time-bucketed metric series and aggregate KPIs for the matched sase_orders.

functions.name: build_sase_order_dashboard
functions.description: Persist a named dashboard composed of widgets (charts, tables, single-stat) over sase_orders data.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Created dashboard descriptor with dashboard_id, shareable URL, and computed first-render preview.

functions.name: upsert_sase_order_policy
functions.description: Create or update a policy/rule used to govern sase_order behavior, validation, or routing.
functions.returns: Persisted policy with policy_id, version, rule count, and validation warnings (if any).

functions.name: list_sase_order_policies
functions.description: List policies governing sase_orders with version, scope, and lifecycle filters.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated policy entries with rule counts and last evaluation metrics.

functions.name: link_sase_order_dependencies
functions.description: Establish or update dependency links between a sase_order and related artefacts.
functions.returns: Updated dependency graph summary with added/removed/updated edges.
